description: This file implements the AWCContainerAdministrator class, including its constructor, destructor, and the Container method, as well as the PluginConfig class for configuration parsing. It manages container instances, sets up listeners, and handles container creation logic.

classes.name: PluginConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for parsing container settings from a JSON string, including proxy usage and timeouts.

classes.name: AWCContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Manages AWC containers, handles creation, and sets up client listeners.

methods.name: PluginConfig::PluginConfig
methods.description: Constructor that parses configuration from a JSON string, setting proxy usage and timeouts.

methods.name: AWCContainerAdministrator::AWCContainerAdministrator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the container administrator and sets up the AWC client and listener.

methods.name: AWCContainerAdministrator::~AWCContainerAdministrator
methods.description: Destructor that removes the listener from the AWC client.

methods.name: AWCContainerAdministrator::Container
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container based on the provided name, configuration, and proxy settings.

methods.name: IContainerAdministrator::Instance
methods.description: Provides singleton access to the AWCContainerAdministrator instance.
